rubric_items.reason: Tests cover every changed path: the awaitingOutcome count, the started=true list filter, the tile and link, and AppointmentsPage passing started through. One gap: no test proves the count ignores the 30-day bound (S-2).
Most assertions check exact ids, totals, hrefs and 400 field errors. The 8-tiles check counts every link on the page, not the tiles.

Covers the start-exactly-at-now boundary, a count of 0, an empty started= value, the 400 for false/yes/1, and the next-day case. Not tested: an empty list behind a 0 count, and a count that drops after an appointment is completed.

Uses Vitest and Supertest with its own PostgreSQL and a fixed clock, and Vitest with jsdom on the web side. Every test name starts with HMS-21 and its REQ id, and files sit in the existing test folders.
Pass/fail counts are left to checks.json and coverage is not claimed, which matches the skipped coverage step in the verifier. The per-file test counts match the files.

findings.text: The REQ-5 test is mapped to S-2, but no Scheduled appointment starts outside Last 30 days. All counted appointments are within a day of now, so a count wrongly limited to 30 days would still pass. S-2 AC1 is not asserted.

cites.quote: On Tuesday 09:00 it is 3 for every period (S-2)
one Scheduled appointment started on 1 August 2026 (outside Last 30 days)

findings.suggested_fix: Move the clock back to book a Scheduled appointment on 1 August 2026. Then assert the count and the started=true list include it for today, 7d and 30d.

findings.text: Some acceptance criteria have no test: S-1 AC5 (the count drops after one appointment is completed) and S-3 AC3 (a 0 count opens an empty list). The REQ-7 zero test never calls the list.

cites.quote: when staff mark one of the two appointments Completed and open the dashboard again, then the tile shows 1
Given the Awaiting outcome tile shows 0, when staff select it, then the appointment list shows no appointments.
REQ-7 edge: the count is 0 before any appointment has started.

findings.suggested_fix: In the REQ-7 test, also call started=true and assert total 0. Add one test that completes an open appointment and checks the count drops by one.

findings.text: The artifact says there are 8 tiles, but the test counts every link on the page. Any other link on the page would make this check wrong.

cites.quote: the Upcoming tile keeps its count and link, and there are 8 tiles

findings.suggested_fix: Count only the tile links, for example by limiting the query to the tile container, or reword the artifact to say 8 links.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script), so no run reports coverage.
Its own database, so no other test's state moves these counts.
